verdict.rationale: gstack's own /learn skill documents exporting what it has learned across sessions. Those learnings are stored locally in an open JSONL file (~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl), so that data is portable. The evidence covers only learnings, not a full export of all user data, and gives no export format details or guidance on leaving. Missing for 10: documented export of all gstack data (e.g., domain skills, telemetry, config), specified export formats, an offboarding/removal path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Review, search, prune, and export what gstack has learned across sessions.
